name: Pitcairn Islands
summary_text: Pitcairn Islands: descendant-community governance; Christian-conservative, no public LGBT life. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: United Kingdom (0.48) plus a local delta of -0.10. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: Judge rules Scottish guidance for housing trans prisoners is unlawful - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This BBC article is about Scotland's prison policy for trans prisoners (June 2026 ruling), not the Pitcairn Islands; included as UK-context material (Pitcairn is a British Overseas Territory).

sources.title: Suicide risk if trans prisoners are put in jails based on sex at birth, court told - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This BBC article is about the same Scottish prison-housing litigation (Feb 2026), not the Pitcairn Islands; included as UK-context material only.
Wikiwand (Wikipedia mirror): transgender rights in the Pitcairn Islands - gender recognition under UK-influenced law; the territory's small population and British legal framework.

sources.title: LGBT rights in the Pitcairn Islands - Alchetron, the free social encyclopedia
sources.claim_summary: Alchetron (Wikipedia-derived): LGBT rights in the Pitcairn Islands - same-sex activity legal since 2001; 2010 constitution bans sexual-orientation discrimination; same-sex marriage since 14 May 2015 (though none of the ~50 islanders is known to be in a same-sex relationship); adoption legal since 2015.

sources.title: LGBTQ rights in the Pitcairn Islands - Readable Wiki
sources.claim_summary: ReadableWiki (Wikipedia-derived): LGBTQ rights in the Pitcairn Islands - marriage defined as union of two people regardless of sex, orientation or gender identity; the Same Sex Marriage and Civil Partnerships Ordinance 2015 also recognises foreign civil partnerships; adoption open to married, unmarried and single people.

sources.title: LGBT rights in the Pitcairn Islands — Wikipedia Republished // WIKI 2
sources.claim_summary: WIKI2 (Wikipedia mirror): LGBT rights in the Pitcairn Islands - legal since 2001, discrimination protections since 2010, same-sex marriage and adoption since 2015; defence is UK responsibility.
